supporting_quotes.exact: Generic trees are a collection of nodes where each node is a data structure that consists of records and a list of references to its children(duplicate references are not allowed).
Unlike the linked list, each node stores the address of multiple nodes.
Every node stores address of its children and the very first node's address will be stored in a separate pointer called root.

observations.subject: generic tree
observations.object: a collection of nodes; each node is a data structure of records plus a list of references to its children; duplicate references are not allowed

observations.subject: generic tree node
observations.object: address of multiple nodes, unlike the linked list

observations.subject: generic tree
observations.object: child addresses in every node; first node's address in a separate pointer called root

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-f9bac1c8c445（"collection of nodes ... records and a list of references to its children(duplicate references are not allowed)"，区间 [0,180)）逐字覆盖 claim 的核心定义：节点=记录+孩子引用列表、不允许重复引用。evidence-46c603cf9e8c（区间 [0,71)）支持"与链表不同，每个节点存储多个节点的地址"。evidence-62968fd58026（区间 [0,125)）支持"每个节点存其孩子地址"与"首节点地址存在单独的 root 指针里"。三条引文共同完整覆盖 claim 的全部三个子句，且与 claim 表述逐字对应，无遗漏、无冲突。

The number of nodes for each node is not known in advance.

observations.subject: generic tree
observations.object: the N-ary trees with the following properties

observations.subject: generic tree node
observations.object: number of nodes not known in advance

claims.rationale: evidence-5263a6f6a6ac（区间 [0,74)）明确指出"Generic trees are the N-ary trees"，直接支持"通用树是 N 叉树"并引出性质列表。evidence-fa4db717e798（区间 [0,28)）为性质之一"Many children at every node"，支持"每个节点可有多个孩子"。evidence-58d6bbdb5a2e（区间 [0,58)）为性质之一"The number of nodes for each node is not known in advance"，支持"每个节点的孩子数量事先未知"（原文用 nodes 指代每个节点的孩子/节点数，与 claim 表述一致）。三引文为同一性质列表，完整覆盖 claim 全部元素。

supporting_quotes.exact: Memory Wastage - All the pointers are not required in all the cases. Hence, there is lot of memory wastage.
Unknown number of children - The number of children for each node is not known in advance.

observations.subject: naive fixed-pointer representation
observations.object: memory wastage; all pointers are not required in all cases

observations.subject: naive fixed-pointer representation
observations.object: unknown number of children; not known in advance

claims.rationale: evidence-5e89cf9c3624（区间 [0,107)）列出缺点"Memory Wastage - All the pointers are not required in all the cases"，支持"多数情况下指针用不到造成大量内存浪费"。evidence-519b571cd237（区间 [0,90)）列出缺点"Unknown number of children - The number of children for each node is not known in advance"，支持"孩子数量事先未知导致容量难以确定"（未知孩子数即无法预分配容量，属直接推理）。两条引文与 claim 的两大缺点一一对应，且在原文中同属对朴素表示的缺点列举，无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: In Linked list, we can not randomly access any child's address. So it will be expensive.
In array, we can randomly access the address of any child, but we can store only fixed number of children's addresses in it.

observations.subject: linked-list storage of child addresses
observations.object: randomly access any child's address; expensive

observations.subject: array storage of child addresses
observations.object: randomly access any child's address but store only fixed number of children's addresses

claims.rationale: evidence-83dfa21cbba1（区间 [0,88)）直接陈述"In Linked list, we can not randomly access any child's address. So it will be expensive."，完整支持"用链表存孩子地址无法随机访问任意孩子的地址（访问代价高）"。evidence-befe247be0b1（区间 [0,124)）直接陈述"we can randomly access the address of any child, but we can store only fixed number of children's addresses"，完整支持"用数组可随机访问，但只能存固定数量的孩子地址"。两条引文分别对应 claim 的链表/数组两分句，逐字对应，无遗漏。

supporting_quotes.exact: We can use Dynamic Arrays for storing the address of children. We can randomly access any child's address and the size of the vector is also not fixed.

observations.subject: dynamic array storage of child addresses
observations.object: random access to any child's address and non-fixed size

claims.rationale: evidence-18a3b8828169（区间 [0,151)）同时给出"We can use Dynamic Arrays for storing the address of children"、"We can randomly access any child's address"与"the size of the vector is also not fixed"，完整支持 claim 的两个性质（随机访问任意孩子地址、容量不固定）。"更好的做法"是 claim 对原文上下文的概括（原文在对比链表/数组后提出该方案，且 "We can use" 表述了建议性），属于对上下文的中性转述，不改变引文所载内容。

supporting_quotes.exact: In the first child/next sibling representation, the steps taken are:
At each node-link the children of the same parent(siblings) from left to right.
Remove the links from parent to all children except the first child.

observations.subject: first child/next sibling representation
observations.object: children of same parent (siblings) from left to right

observations.subject: first child/next sibling representation
observations.object: links from parent to all children except the first child

claims.rationale: evidence-e5dcfc7cecfe（区间 [0,68)）给出表示法名称"first child/next sibling representation"并引出步骤。evidence-dc543a38b4da（区间 [0,79)）为步骤 1"link the children of the same parent(siblings) from left to right"，支持"把同一父节点的孩子们（兄弟）从左到右链接起来"。evidence-9b50296a1951（区间 [0,68)）为步骤 2"Remove the links from parent to all children except the first child"，支持"移除父节点指向除第一个孩子之外其他孩子的链接"。claim 中的"左孩子/右兄弟"为 first child/next sibling 的标准译名，两条步骤引文完整覆盖 claim 的两个动作。

supporting_quotes.exact: Memory efficient - No extra links are required, hence a lot of memory is saved.
Treated as binary trees - Since we are able to convert any generic tree to binary representation, we can treat all generic trees with a first child/next sibling representation as binary trees.
Many algorithms can be expressed more easily because it is just a binary tree.
Each node is of fixed size ,so no auxiliary array or vector is required.

observations.subject: first child/next sibling representation
observations.object: memory efficient; no extra links required

observations.subject: first child/next sibling representation
observations.object: treating all generic trees as binary trees; convert any generic tree to binary representation

observations.subject: first child/next sibling representation
observations.object: many algorithms expressed more easily because it is a binary tree

observations.subject: first child/next sibling representation
observations.object: each node of fixed size; no auxiliary array or vector required

claims.rationale: 四条引文与 claim 的四项优点一一对应：evidence-24f1ad12af22（区间 [0,79)）"Memory efficient - No extra links are required"支持"内存高效（不需要额外链接）"; evidence-e4d90aa02a5b（区间 [0,191)）"convert any generic tree to binary representation ... treat ... as binary trees"支持"任何通用树都能转成这种二叉表示"与"可按二叉树处理"（"用 firstChild/nextSibling 取代左右指针"是该表示法命名的固有含义，原文以 "first child/next sibling representation ... as binary trees" 直接承载该含义，属轻量推断而非新增事实）; evidence-f08329fa0d14（区间 [0,78)）"Many algorithms can be expressed more easily"支持"许多算法因它就是二叉树而更容易表达"; evidence-8266d22eb01e（区间 [0,72)）"Each node is of fixed size, so no auxiliary array or vector is required"支持"每个节点定长，无需辅助数组或向量"。全部 4 子句均获证据支持。
